This page documents the changes from the [last stable Minecraft release](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol "Protocol") (currently [1.12.2, protocol 340](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol_version_numbers?action=edit&redlink=1 "Protocol version numbers (page does not exist)")) to the current pre-release (currently [1.12.2, protocol 340](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol_version_numbers?action=edit&redlink=1 "Protocol version numbers (page does not exist)")). Note that this page contains bleeding-edge information that may not be completely or correctly documented.

One who wishes to commandeer the merging of this into [Protocol](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Protocol "Protocol") when an update is made must be sure to respect any changes that may have occurred to the respective packets there.
